facts: This batch of cases deals with the dispute between the direct recruits and the promotees in the cadre of U.P. Higher judicial service comprising of posts borne in class 1.
The present rules govern the conditions of service including recruitment of the members of the service constituting a cadre.

Under the recruitment rules, more particularly in rule 8, the court is required from time to time, but not later than 3 years from the last recruitment, to fix the number of officers to be taken at the recruitment, keeping in view the vacancies then existing, and likely to occur in the next 2 years.
The joint registrar, Allahabad high court issued an advertisement for direct recruitment to the U.P. higher judicial services on 27.7.89 and the total number of vacancies indicated therein was 5.
A selection committee was constituted under rule 16, comprising of three hon'ble judges of the court.
Though the full court had approved the names of 68 promotees but in march 91 only 16 of them were appointed to higher judicial service.

In the meanwhile, the selection committee constituted under rule 16 for selecting personnel for direct recruitment being of the opinion, that more direct recruits could be appointed than the number of posts advertised, prepared a list on 28.3.1991 of 9 persons.
issues: The calculation made by the high court to find out the ratio between direct recruits and promotees in a given year.
What should be the correct mode of calculation whereafter the high court may itself re-calculate and re-adjust the appointments already made or to be made in future.
How the quota for various sources of recruitment shall be applied.
Whether the recruitment rules must be duly implemented.
petitioner_arguments: The promotees argued that the recruitment rules must be duly implemented and while taking steps for filling up the post by direct recruitment from the bar, steps should also be taken for filling up the quota available for promotees simultaneously.
respondent_arguments: No respondent arguments mentioned in the text.
court_reasoning: The court proposed to interpret the relevant provisions of the rules and decide what should be the correct mode of calculation whereafter the high court may itself re-calculate and re-adjust the appointments already made or to be made in future.

The court is required from time to time, but not later than 3 years from the last recruitment, to fix the number of officers to be taken at the recruitment, keeping in view the vacancies then existing, and likely to occur in the next 2 years.
holding: No specific holding mentioned in the text. The judgment appears to be a preliminary decision or an interim order.
